headline: Pros and Cons of Heat Pump Water Heaters
subheading: Heat pump water heaters are the most efficient way to heat water by a wide margin. They also cost more, run slower, and need space and a drain. Here are 9 pros and 9 cons to weigh before you buy one.
seoTitle: Heat Pump Water Heater Pros and Cons: 9 of Each
description: Heat pump water heaters use a third of the energy of standard models but cost more up front. The 9 pros and 9 cons to weigh before you install one.
